text:
elaine: quick joy drop 12 meet Pico the bearded dragon. mid-lamp lounge and somehow photogenic? https://imgur.com/fakePico1.jpg 
noah: he looks like he's charging his vibes for the week. tiny sunbeam battery pack. 
kevin: beard scale detail is immaculate. also is that a sweater?? 
maya: yes please tell me more about the sweater. did he knit it himself? :sweater:
elaine: @maya knitted by my neighbors grandma. Its a tiny argyle. He only tolerates it for 2 minutes then becomes The Regal Lizard. 
noah: honorary office mascot? he already has the "silent judge" energy 
kevin: devbot: Upload complete: pico_lamp_lounge_01.jpg (2.9 MB) 
elaine: bonus clip: he does a slow nod when the thermostat kicks on https://imgur.com/fakePico2.mp4 
maya: petition to start meetings with a 30-second Pico stare to center ourselves 
noah: 100% in. also offering to bring kale chips as tribute (he will not eat them, but it's the thought) 
kevin: wondering if beard glow is an internal mood indicator. bright = happy, dim = plotting escape 
elaine: hes bright when sun and snacks align. dim when i say the word "vet" 
maya: can we get a tiny nameplate for his lamp perch? "Pico, Chief Warmth Officer" 
noah: engraved. available in oak or driftwood. 
kevin: sending a tiny crown emoji (in spirit). :crown: 
devbot: Message pinned by elaine: pico_lamp_lounge_01.jpg 
elaine: thanks friends. will post a weekly Pico update. requests for sweater color combos accepted in thread :)
